_meta.description: D6 fixtures for ms-agent-python / a2ui-recovery (A2UI error recovery)
_meta._note: Backend-owned A2UI (recovery_agent.py, enable_a2ui, injectA2UITool=false) with the shared toolkit validate->retry recovery loop made visible. NO `context` match field anywhere: a real browser does NOT send the x-aimock-context header (only the test harness does), so context-scoped fixtures would 404 in-browser. The recovery pills' prompts are UNIQUE per framework (distinct from langgraph-python's), so userMessage alone disambiguates without needing context. Flow per pill: the render sub-agent runs with messages [system(base_prompt), *conversation] (agent_framework_ag_ui _agent.py _subagent_messages), so the inner render_a2ui request carries the ORIGINAL user prompt as its last user message; the retry augments the SYSTEM prompt only, so userMessage stays constant across attempts and sequenceIndex 0/1 disambiguates them. The inner-render fixtures are listed FIRST and carry toolName=render_a2ui so they win for the inner calls; the tool-less outer generate_a2ui emit falls through to the userMessage-only fixture; the outer narration is matched by the unique toolCallId of the emit (its balancing tool result). HEAL: attempt 1 (seq 0) invalid (dangling child) -> retry -> attempt 2 (seq 1) valid -> paints (declarative-metric x2). EXHAUST: invalid on every attempt -> recovery exhausts -> a2ui_recovery_exhausted. Requires agent-framework-ag-ui[a2ui]>=1.2.0.
